translation.name: Le'ec Ada' U T'an A Dios A Tumulbene

book.name: EFESIOS
book.title: Le'ec Ada' a Carta u Tz'iibtaj aj Pablo Ti'ijoo' a Hermano ich Caj Efeso.

content: Le'ec a c'u' a yanoo' u betic u mejenoo' a Dioso.
Pues te'i. Yajtzilo'on u men a Dioso. U mejeno'on a Dioso, mentücü, yan ti betic a jabix ilic a walac u betic a Dioso.

Yacunte'ex tulacal mac jabix ilic ti yaj u yubo'on a Cristojo. Ala'aji, u c'ubaj u bajil ca' quimsabüc tiqui woc'lal ti'i ca' u qui'cunto'on etel a Dioso. Qui' tu wich a Dios c'u' u betaj a Cristojo, bete cuenta u tz'aj a sij-ool a top qui' u boc ti'i a Dioso.
Ino'ono, ti'ijo'on Dios. Ma' a betique'ex ma'ax a tzicbaltique'ex a cüjtal ta bajile'ex, ma'ax aj ma'su'talil, ma'ax a tz'i'lajbülü.

Ma' a c'ac'ast'antique'ex a winiqui, wa ix ch'upu. Ma' a wadique'ex a c'ac'as cuenta, ma'ax a c'ac'as baxült'ana. Ma' qui' u yaalbül a jabix abe' u menoo' a hermanojo. Mas toj ti tz'eec a bo'tic ti'i a Dioso.

U'ye'ex u tojil. Le'ec a walac u cüjtal etel ulaac'a, wa le'ec aj ma'su'tala, wa le'ec a walac u tz'i'laja, ma' yanoo' u cuuchil tu cuenta a Cristo etel ilic a Dioso. Le'ec mac a walac u tz'i'laja, walac u c'ajsic c'u' a tan u tz'i'lic jabix u dios.

Ma' a cha'ique'ex a bajil ca' cho'boque'ex u men ma'ax mac etel a t'an a ma'ax c'u' aj beele. U men boon a sip'il abe' in wadaj tojo, le'ec a Dioso, walac u tz'eec a mac a ma' ta'achoo' u tz'ocsaj t'an ichil u sip'il ti top yaj.
Ma' qui' ca' ti wet'octoo' a cristiano a jabix abe' ichil a sip'il a tanoo' u betiqui.

Biq'uin ado'o, ma' toje'ex a na'at. Que'ene'ex to ichil a jabix a ac'ü'ü. C'u' betic aleebe, tojaji a na'ate'ex u men a Noochtzili. Que'ene'ex tun ichil a sasili. Yan a betique'ex c'u' a qui' u betabül u men que'ene'ex tun ichil a sasili.
Ichil a sasili, te'i yan a qui'i. Yan a tojo. Yan a jaja.
Tz'aje'ex a wool a cüne'ex c'u' a qui' tu wich a Noochtzili.

Ma' a betique'ex ma'ax a wocsique'ex a bajil etel a c'u' a walacoo' u betic a que'enoo' to ichil a jabix a ac'ü'ü. Ma' ta'ach u yantal a qui'il etel c'u' a walacoo' u betiqui. Yan ti chicbesicoo' u c'asil
u men top c'as a walacoo' u betic ich mucul. Top suductzil u tzicbalbül.
Le'ec a c'u' a walac u tich'bil u men a sasili, chica'an c'u'i. Baalo' ilic ala'oo' a tanoo' u betic a c'asa. Wa ca' tich'bicoo' u men a sasili, uchac u c'ümicoo' a sasil abe'e, le'ec a jaja.

Baalo' ilic ti tz'iiba'an yoc'ol a que'en to ichil a jabix a ac'ü'ü: —Liq'uen ichil a wüyül ca' c'aac a winiquil. Joq'uen tu yaamoo' a jabix quimen a ma' ti'ijoo' a Diosi. Ca' a bete' ti baalo'o, bel u cu tojquinteech a Cristo etel u sasilil,— cu t'an a t'an a tz'iiba'ana.
Pues te'i. Tucle'ex c'u' a bele'ex a ca'a a bete'. Ma' a betique'ex a jabix a mac a ma' u yeel c'u' a tan u betiqui. Bete'ex a jabix a mac a seeb u yoolo.
Le'ec ca' yanac biquiji, ca' a bete'ex a qui'il, u men top yan a c'as yoc'olcab aleebe.
Ma' a betique'ex jabix ma'ax c'u' a weele'ex. Tz'aje'ex a wool a cüne'ex biqui'il u c'ati a Noochtzili.
Ma' a na'ajcuntique'ex a bajil etel a vinojo. Chen walac u yantal a c'asil etel abe'e. Que'en cuchi u Püsüc'al a Dios ichile'ex a püsüc'al jabix cuchi na'aje'ex u mene.
Ade'ex ta bajil a Salmo
, a c'ay ti'i Dios ca'ax chawac ca'ax coom. Uchuque'ex a c'ay ti'i a Noochtzili. Bete'ex abe' tulacale'ex a wool.
Etel u c'aba' ti Noochil a Jesucristojo, tz'aje'ex a bo'tic ti'i Dios a Tattzili. Tz'aje'ex a bo'tic tulacal q'uin yoc'ol tulacal.
Le'ec biqui'il u cuxtal a hermano ichil u yotoch.
Pues te'i. Tz'ocse'ex a yanil ta bajile'ex u men tane'ex ilic a tz'ocsic u yanil a Cristojo.
Ütantzile'ex, tz'ocse'ex u yaniloo' a wicham jabix ilic ti tane'ex a tz'ocsic u yanil a Noochtzili.
Le'ecoo' a ichamtzili, u noochiloo' u yütan jabix ilic a Cristo eteloo' a hermanojo. Le'ec a Cristo jabix u pol. Le'ecoo' a hermanojo, jabix u büq'uel. Ala'aji, u yaj Sa'aliloo'.
Jabix ilic ti tan u tz'ocsic a Cristo a hermanojo, baalo' ilic ti yanoo' u tz'ocsic u yicham a ütantziloo' etel tulacal.
Ichamtzile'ex, yacunte'exoo' a wütan jabix ilic ti yajtziloo' a hermano u men a Cristojo. U c'ubaj u bajil ca' quimsabüc yoc'laloo' a hermano u men top yaj u yuboo'.
U c'ubaj u bajil ti baalo' ti'i ca' p'aatücoo' a hermano ti'i a Dioso. U sa'tesaj ti sip'il ichil u quimil, bete cuenta u yichnesajo'on etel a ja'a, y etel u t'an ca' joc'oc a c'as tiqui woc'ol.

U betaj abe'e, ti'i ca' p'aatüc a hermano ti'i ilic ala'aji. Tojajo'on ti bel ti ca'a c'ubbul ti'i ilic u bajil jabixo'on a noc' a ma' yan a bonol tuwichi, ma'ax wo'wo'och, tulacal. Ti u q'uinil u c'ubbulo'on a hermanojo'ono, jumbelo'on etel a Dioso. Ma' yan a c'as yoc'olo'on.

Jabix ilic ti yaj u yubo'on ti baalo' a Cristojo, baalo' ilique'ex a ichamtzile'exe. Yane'ex a yacunticoo' a wütane'ex jabix ilic a jujun tuule'exe, yaj a wu'yi a bajil ta bajil. Le'ec mac a tan u yacuntic u yütana, tan ilic u yacuntic u bajil.
Ma' yan a winic a motz ti'i u bajil tu bajil. Walac u tzeentic u büq'uel. Walac u cününtic u büq'uel jabix ilic ti walac u cününbüloo' a hermano u men a Cristo
u men le'eco'on a hermanojo'ono, jabixo'on u büq'uel y u baquel a Cristojo.
—U men abe'e, le'ec a winiqui, yan u p'ütic u na' u tat ti tan u ch'a'ic u yütan. Le'ec a ca' tuulu, p'aatül u ca'a ti jun tuul ilicoo' tu bajil,— cu t'an a t'an a tz'iiba'ana.
Top yaj u ch'a'bül u tojil a t'an abe'e, pero tin t'an inene, tan u tzicbalbül biqui'il a Cristo eteloo' a hermanojo.
A jujun tuule'exe, yane'ex ilic a yacuntic a wütan xan jabix ilic ti yaje'ex a wu'yi a bajile'ex ta bajile'exe. Le'ec ilic u yütana, yan u tz'ocsic u yanil u yicham.
